lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrZn₂Sn crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms—Sr₄Zn₈Sn₂—distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Sn centers with 14 geometric neighbors (2 Sn, 6 Sr, 6 Zn), while Sr and Zn centers each have 12 neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner, edge, and face sharing among Sn, Sr, and Zn 12-vertex coordination polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
